picks.what: The South Blockhouse and harbor defenses, etching (detail of Hollar’s map of Hull)
picks.why: Hollar’s accurate drawing of Hull’s blockhouse, town houses and shipping

picks.what: The pier and waterfront, aquatint in William Daniell’s Voyage Round Great Britain
picks.why: colored, high-resolution view of the Humber waterfront; mount and title trimmed

gaps: P0, P2: nothing; P4–P6: all candidates are of Hull, Massachusetts, Toledo, Bergen or Chicago (wrong place)
notes: Hollar’s print is dated 1636–44 on Commons; labeled ‘about 1640’. Alternate for P3: Balmer/Finden 1840 (#4), a black-and-white view across the Humber showing more of the town front; Daniell chosen for color and resolution.
